title: One-dimensional endpoint Sobolev inequality sup|v| ≤ ½∫|Dv| for C¹ compactly supported functions on ℝ^1 (erratum E6)
statement: Let ℝ^1 = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) carry its volume L^1. Every C¹ function v : ℝ^1 → ℝ with compact support satisfies eLpNorm(v, ∞, L^1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(½ ∫ ‖Dv(y)‖ dL^1(y)). Here Dv(y) = fderiv ℝ v y, ‖·‖ is the operator norm, and eLpNorm(·, ∞) is the essential supremum.
lean_statement: ∀ v : Rn 1 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v → eLpNorm v ∞ volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 * ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ v y‖)
